title: Type-Voltage Covers and Finite Locally Kneser Graphs
summary: For every $d\geq3$ we construct a connected graph of order $2\binom{3d+1}{d}$ that is locally $K(2d+1,d)$. Fix a block $A$ and put $a'=\min(|A|,3d+1-|A|)$. Among the loopless binary voltages on the fixed labeled base $K(3d+1,d)$ that depend only on the intersection types with $A$, the local-neighborhood-preserving assignments form, modulo gauge, an $\mathbb F_2$-space of dimension $[q^{a'-5}]\binom{d}{3}_q$, with explicit canonical coordinates. Adjacent-line rigidity holds on $2d+2\leq n\leq3d$: every loopless fixed-block type-invariant local-neighborhood-preserving binary voltage is gauge…
